name: HSnare
description:
808/909 analog snare on a phrase pad. Hold to run. X = hit density (2-and-4 toward every 16th), Y = 808 toward 909.
Still being fine-tuned; the official release is coming soon.

params.name: DENS
params.detail: Euclidean hits per bar, rotated onto beats 2 and 4 (1–16, then 32nd flams)

params.name: TYPE
params.detail: 808 (bottom: bridged-T shells, one HPF snappy) to 909 (top: triangle VCOs, pitch bend, split snappy)

params.name: TUNE
params.detail: Shell pitch (909 Tune; also shifts the 808 T-networks)
